column1: # dispatch-tier-bindings.tsv -- DGN-1218 LAYER 2: (runtime, axis) -> measured models.
# DATA, not logic. The gate (dispatch-detached.sh bottleneck_gate) reads this
# file and contains no model names itself. Adding a runtime = adding rows here.
# Columns (TAB-separated): runtime  axis  models(comma-separated)  evidence
# Axis semantics (Layer 1, provider-neutral -- properties of the TASK):
#   coverage  = exhaustive enumeration; one omission voids the artifact
#   accuracy  = verifying N given items; being wrong is the risk, not missing
#   judgment  = the verdict itself is the work (design/security/tradeoff)
# claude-code rows = DGN-1193 disk-truth replay measurement (2026-09-02):
#   coverage: sonnet recall 44-74% on exhaustive tasks -> opus and above only.
#   accuracy: sonnet precision 91.4% ~= opus 92.7% at ~1/5 cost -> sonnet.
#   judgment: unmeasurable downward (the verdict needs the top tier) -> fable.
#   haiku: EXCLUDED from the dispatch ladder (measured 3 tasks independently:
#     worse than sonnet at higher token cost, N-rate up to 56%). Exclusion is
#     expressed as DATA: haiku appears in no row, so choosing it always
#     requires an explicit --why (recorded) -- never a silent pass.
#   Unmeasured axis note: root-cause/tracing tasks have 0 valid samples yet
#     (DGN-1193); classify them by their true bottleneck among the 3 axes.
# Effort (DGN-1770): the reasoning-effort default per (runtime, axis, model)
# lives in the sibling DATA file dispatch-effort-bindings.tsv, which
# dispatch-detached.sh resolve_effort() reads. Effort wording inside the
# evidence column below is history, not the live value -- in particular the
# codex accuracy row's "medium default" was superseded there (astra a2:
# medium cost the same wall time as high and scored like low).
# codex rows: MEASURED 2026-09-27 (DGN-1750 effort bench, see evidence column);
# judgment row removed on purpose (owner 14:09) so judgment work stays on claude.
# History -- codex rows (DGN-1444, 2026-09-13): were UNMEASURED -- owner-proposed, mirroring
# the claude-code binding above as a starting point (same alias vocabulary;
# MODEL stays fable/opus/sonnet/haiku regardless of runtime -- see
# dispatch-detached.sh codex_slug_for_model). Do NOT read these as measured:
# the claude-code rows are DGN-1193 replay measurement over many tasks; these
# are the owner's initial guess pending real data. One real datapoint exists
# on the judgment axis (n=1, 2026-09-13: anchor-B v3.2 lock-grill run on both
# Fable and codex's astra tier, same prompt -- Fable found deeper analysis
# gpt-6-astra missed, astra ran ~2.5x faster; see DGN-1444 "첫 런타임 측정").
# n=1 does not overturn the owner's default -- cited here as a single
# datapoint, not a measurement, and it must not be generalized.
# antigravity / openrouter: still UNMEASURED -- no rows on purpose, same
# pass-through-with-notice contract as codex before this ticket (2026-09-02
# owner decision: multi-provider build-out is 3.0; until measured, the
# design must not block a new runtime, only record it).
claude-code
